label: An own being's unexercised self-directed capacity leaves it in potency in understanding
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: for every being that is its own being and every content about it that it can itself apprehend, either it actually apprehends that content or it is in potency in the designated understanding respect. Potency is the independently supplied InPotency (DEF-INDEPENDENT-POTENCY), not 'capable and not actually'; under that reading a dormant self-directed capacity without potency is a coherent assignment, so the bridge is substantive.
